title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1998 During 1998, only 24 States/UTs provided training to their Staff. Of the 24 States/UTs, Madhya Pradesh (690) ranked high in reporting various training programmes imparted to their staff during the year. This was followed by Andhra Pradesh (428) and Uttar Pradesh (311).
